title: Don't Patronize Me! An Annotated Dataset with Patronizing and Condescending Language towards Vulnerable Communities

bias_targets.methodology: Creating a human-annotated dataset of news paragraphs containing keywords like 'homeless', 'poor families', and 'in need', and evaluating machine learning models (SVM, BiLSTM, BERT, RoBERTa) on their ability to detect and categorize patronizing and condescending language (PCL).

Creating a human-annotated dataset of news paragraphs containing keywords like 'immigrant', 'migrant', and 'refugee', and evaluating supervised text classification models to identify subtle condescension and patronizing discourse.
Extracting and annotating news text mentioning the keyword 'disabled' to test standard machine learning and transformer models on identifying condescension, pity, and superficial saviour narratives.
Extracting and annotating news text containing the keyword 'women' to establish a baseline for how well NLP language models detect patronizing and condescending language targeted at women.
